builds.name: Blade Tome Counter
builds.desc:
Stat spread is 36/43/34/12/31.
Barb Shuriken+ is taken over Kitty Paddle+ because it aids survivability, increases Arena score, and debuffs all enemy types, not just mages. Aether is taken to increase Arena score considerably, which is important for her low BST. This can be traded out for Iceberg to give a few more favorable matchups.

builds.name: Dancing Debuffer
builds.desc:
Stat spread is 36/40/39/12/28.
Olivia's job has been and always will be to Dance, but this build takes advantage of her stat spread to give her additional utility as a team debuffer. The weapon of choice here is Smoke Dagger+ with a Spd upgrade. This upgrade brings a devastating effect, which deals -6 Atk/Spd/Def/Res to target and foes within 2 spaces.
For her passives, Swift Sparrow 2 is taken to help her poor Atk stat and ensure that Windsweep 3/ Watersweep 3 activates. Her C-slot and S-slot remain Flexible to fit your team's needs. Field/combat buffs are solid options, or Savage Blow 3 and Poison Strike 3 can be used to add some chip damage to your debuffs.
The best special for this build is Aether. Since Olivia will likely only attack once or twice, and each will be a guaranteed single hit because of Windsweep, Aether is chosen to increase Arena score considerably, which is important due to her low BST. For other game modes, Aether can be still be taken or can be switched to Moonbow or another special.

builds.name: Player Phase Mage Masher
builds.desc: This build focuses on a more aggressive Olivia that can take out several tome users while also debuffing their surrounding allies. Watersweep grants a bit of protection against tankier mages, but even with Life and Death, she still has enough Res to reliably tank a counter hit, allowing for desperation to take effect. With desperation, she can fight other dagger users, bow users, and less tanky melee units. Because she has decreased Res, it's better to take an Atk boosting or Def lowering special. Her C slot is entirely flexible, but buffs are recommended to aid her team along with her dancing. I like to use Atk Smoke because it means you take 3 stats down all at once if you are using an upgraded Dancer's Fan.

builds.name: AOE Debuff Queen
builds.desc: The refined dagger gives her a bit more attack which helps out her pathetic atk stat and with desperation active she can ORKO some archers and mages before they get the chance to attack her. This makes her a little more versatile and less specialized. Her target recieces def/res/(atk or spd) -7 if you don't like desperation, and enemies within range get all stats -7 which can really turn the tides of things and can make armor emblem teams much easier to deal with as they are very clumped up.
